OUR APPROACH
PHASE 03

General Availability
& Optimization
Weeks 35 - 42

We will harden both the platform and operating model by embedding
governance throughout the rollout & optimization processes
TWO CRITICAL PATHWAYS TO OPERATIONALIZE UHG’s PLATFORM GOVERNANCE
Request-to-provisioning intake: Team identified to approved pattern access
Use-case/Optimization intake: New idea to governed build, deployment, and monitoring

Result: Controlled Fabric scale, approval-only tool access, governed
data patterns, and a repeatable model for future use cases.

Designed to align with UHG’s existing governance structure, Data Enablement team,
Enterprise L&D, security, and operational support functions.
Make governance executable

Scale depends on clear decision rights,
auditable controls, and operational handoffs -
not one-time enablement.

•   Named approvers
•   SLA tracking
•   Access controls
•   Measured adoption
